title: Car Wash Brush with Telescopic Handle – Double Brush Head
seo_title: Car Wash Brush with Telescopic Handle
seo_description: Car wash brush with double microfiber head and stainless steel telescopic handle, 100 cm total. Easy to hold with one arm – tracked delivery.
descriptionHtml:
Your back aches before half the car is washed

You stand bent over the hood with a sponge that has to be rinsed out every ten seconds, and your arm barely reaches past the middle of the roof before it runs out. In the end it's easier to skip the wash than to get the bucket out again.

A handle that reaches where your arm doesn't

The brush head is double and 25 cm wide, so every sweep covers more than an ordinary sponge. The handle is telescopic stainless steel and extends to a total of 100 cm, yet weighs just 335 grams – light enough to hold out with one arm all the way around the car.

Features

  • You don't have to stand bent over the hood – the stainless steel telescopic handle extends to a total of 100 cm.
  • One sweep covers more than an ordinary sponge – the brush head is double and 25 cm wide in microfiber.
  • The right length for a regular car – 100 cm total reaches around the sides, hood and trunk of a passenger car; not built for the roof of an SUV or motorhome.
  • Your arm can handle the whole wash – the brush weighs 335 grams.
  • Stainless steel handle – and a double brush head in gray microfiber.

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.
